name: @pinpoint/geocode
comment: Turns a typed query into candidate places. Unlike @pinpoint/map, which is data and pure functions and may not perform I/O at all, this package exists to talk to two external services — Photon while somebody types, Nominatim when they submit to search names in every language — but it never reaches a global to do it: the caller passes a fetch function, exactly as @pinpoint/auth and @pinpoint/data are passed a client. That keeps the request building, the response parsing, the pacing and the type guessing testable with no network and no stubbed global, which is where this package's value actually is. Its workspace dependencies are @pinpoint/map, for the marker type identifiers a candidate is guessed into and the distance a candidate carries, and @pinpoint/wording, for the name of the message a failed search reports.
